campaigns.description: Two adjacent leaders on a tiny grassland map -- for fast combat-math debugging, no setup turns needed.

campaigns.description: Two tiny scenarios chained by next_scenario=, with a real gold/recall carryover setup -- for fast progression debugging.

campaigns.name: [Debug] Abilities & Specials

campaigns.name: [Debug] Unit Advancement
campaigns.description: Two real units one combat-XP gain from leveling up -- one with a single real advances_to= option (advances immediately), one with three (opens the real advancement-choice dialog) -- for fast advancement debugging.
